_comment: GENERATED by scripts/export_tools.py from app/tools.py — do not edit by hand. Live tools for the Suisse Line agent. Each tool = POST {BASE_URL}{path} with header X-Api-Key: {TOOL_API_KEY}. Parameter schemas use only the JSON-Schema subset Suisse Line accepts (no format/pattern/oneOf). tests/test_suisse_line_config.py enforces this.

tools.name: lookup_caller
tools.description: Call this FIRST in every call. Returns today's date and time (needed to resolve 'tomorrow', 'next Thursday'), today's opening hours, whether the caller is a returning customer (name, last service, last stylist), their upcoming appointments and any pending waitlist offer.

phone.description: Caller's phone number from caller ID, e.g. +41791234567. Empty if unknown.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Find free appointment times. Returns at most 3 options (start time + stylist). If the requested day is closed or full it returns the next free options and says whether the waitlist is possible. Never invent times — only offer what this tool returns.

date.description: Requested day as YYYY-MM-DD. Leave empty for 'as soon as possible'.

preferred_time.description: Specific wished time as HH:MM, e.g. 14:30. Options closest to it come first.

tools.name: book_appointment
tools.description: Book an appointment. Only call after the caller explicitly confirmed service, day, time, stylist, name and phone number. Use start and stylist exactly as returned by check_availability. If the slot was just taken, returns ok=false with new options.

customer_name.description: First and last name of the customer, spelled as confirmed.

notes.description: Optional short note, e.g. 'first colour, patch test needed' or 'very long hair'.

tools.name: find_appointments
tools.description: List the upcoming appointments booked under a phone number. Use before cancelling or moving an appointment.

tools.name: cancel_appointment
tools.description: Cancel one appointment of the caller after they confirmed which one. Returns late_cancellation=true if less than 24 hours before (mention the cancellation policy politely). The freed slot is automatically offered to the waitlist.

phone.description: Caller's phone number (must match the booking).

tools.name: reschedule_appointment
tools.description: Move an existing appointment to a new time the caller chose from check_availability. The old appointment is only released if the new one could be booked.

phone.description: Caller's phone number (must match the booking).

appointment_id.description: appointment_id of the appointment to move.

new_start.description: New start as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, from check_availability.

stylist.description: Stylist for the new slot; empty keeps the same stylist if possible.

tools.name: join_waitlist
tools.description: Put the caller on the waitlist when no offered time fits. As soon as a matching slot frees up (cancellation), the salon calls them back with an offer.

tools.name: accept_offer
tools.description: The caller accepts a pending waitlist offer (from lookup_caller.pending_offer). Books the held slot.

tools.name: decline_offer
tools.description: The caller declines a pending waitlist offer. They stay on the waitlist; the slot goes to the next person.
